I build data pipelines and turn messy, real-world data into decisions
people can act on. Right now I am finishing my M.S. in Data Science at
**Willamette University**, where my capstone
[quantifies cross-court groundstroke accuracy](capstone.qmd) for the
Willamette Men's Tennis coaching staff and players.

I care about sports analytics, reproducible workflows, and being honest
about what a dataset can and can't tell you, my capstone's biggest finding
was a confound in my own experimental design, and reporting that clearly
mattered more than forcing a clean result.

**Currently looking for** data analyst / data scientist / business analyst
roles starting september 2026. [Get in touch](about.qmd) or grab my
[resume](resume.qmd).
